scenario.question: Show me intraday concentration of open interest by member, broken out by product, in 15-minute buckets — for the rates complex over the last 5 trading days.

upstream_models.description: Every order add / modify / cancel / fill from FIX gateway.
Cleared, novated executions joined to product reference.
End-of-day position from clearinghouse — needs intraday derivation.
Clearing-member reference: parent, FCM type, KYC tier.

steps.label: Discovery
steps.note: dbt search 'open interest' returns fct_clearing_position. dbt status confirms 0 gold models cover member × product × 15m grain.

steps.label: Schema understanding
steps.note: Lineage trace shows silver tables are intraday; 15-min bucket needs to be derived from event_ts using date_trunc('minute') with floor() to 15.

steps.label: Data inspection
steps.note: dbt_show pulls a 5-day slice into an XS warehouse to validate the join. Row counts match. No null members.

steps.label: Model creation
steps.note: SQL written: aggregate cumulative position by member × product, bucketed 15-min, with running OI and pct-of-total.

steps.label: Test authoring
steps.note: YAML written. Uniqueness on (member_id, product_id, dt, bucket_15m). Not-null on member_id, product_id, oi_contracts. Accepted-range on oi_pct between 0 and 100.

steps.label: Materialization
steps.note: dbt run materializes to gold/Iceberg. Run-time agents and Tableau risk dashboard pick it up on next read. Risk Committee briefing now uses live numbers.

outcome.callout: From CRO's question to a tested, materialized, queryable gold model in 92 seconds — manual ETA was 5 to 8 days. The Risk Committee gets live numbers.
